NYE is on December 31st, 2026
New Years Day Is January 1st 2027

Book Your NYE Parties Today With California Disc Jockeys ! 1-415-350-5474

When is NYE and New Year’s Day in 2026?
NYE is on December 31st, 2026. New Year’s Day is January 1st, 2026.
How can I book my NYE party with California Disc Jockeys?
Call us today at 1-415-350-5474 to book your New Year’s Eve party!
Do you offer emergency party planning?
Yes! Emergency Party Planning is available. Call us at 415-350-5474 if you’re in a rush to plan your end-of-year party.
Do you have bilingual DJs for Chinese New Year events?
Yes, we offer Bilingual Chinese & Asian DJs with a wide range of music for Chinese New Year celebrations.
What other events do you provide DJs for in December and January?
We offer DJs for December weddings, New Year’s wedding receptions, Hanukkah, Bar Mitzvahs, Latin events (Feliz Navidad), Indian NYE parties, Asian New Year, company parties, school events, reunions, birthday/anniversary parties, Quinceañeras, karaoke nights, and more!
Do you provide additional services like lighting or sound?
Yes, we offer laser light shows, sound systems, and lighting services as part of our DJ packages.
Where can I submit a booking request?
You can submit your booking through our online form or call us directly for quick support.
